cohort: Extremely preterm or extremely low birth weight (EP/ELBW) infants discharged from 26 tertiary neonatal intensive care units or died during hospitalization from 2008 to 2017
finding: Hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) increased the risk of periventricular leukomalacia (PVL) in EP/ELBW infants, but had no significant effect on the survival rate at discharge, or the occurrence of other complications.
